title: BITTRACE
tagline: Offline Bitcoin transaction and network metadata investigation platform.
shortDescription: An offline Bitcoin investigation platform correlating network and blockchain metadata using explainable ML (Isolation Forest, DBSCAN) to rank investigative leads.
description: BITTRACE is an offline Bitcoin transaction and network metadata investigation platform built for Smart India Hackathon 2026 (NTRO). It ingests bulk blockchain/network metadata, builds entity graphs, and employs explainable ML to identify anomalies and rank investigative leads in an offline environment.

caseStudy.problem: Investigators analyzing suspicious Bitcoin transactions face massive volumes of unlinked network and transaction metadata, with strict security constraints requiring completely offline analysis without external cloud APIs.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a secure offline-first intelligence platform that ingests CSV/JSON/XML datasets, resolves entities across IP/ASN and blockchain records, constructs NetworkX graph models, and generates explainable ML risk scores using Isolation Forest and DBSCAN.
features: Offline bulk ingestion & normalization for CSV, JSON, and XML metadata
Local GeoIP & ASN offline database resolution
Network and blockchain metadata correlation engine
Interactive graph visualization powered by Cytoscape.js and Recharts
Explainable anomaly detection via Isolation Forest and DBSCAN clustering
Investigator lead ranking with detailed confidence and risk breakdown
FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL storage and local caching
caseStudy.challenges: Correlating multi-dimensional network features with transaction graphs offline without external API lookups while ensuring ML anomaly scoring remains transparent and interpretable for human investigators.
caseStudy.outcome: Engineered a working MVP intelligence pipeline capable of offline entity resolution, graph generation, and anomaly ranking for SIH2026 / NTRO problem statement.
caseStudy.learnings: Offline ML pipeline design with scikit-learn, high-performance graph modeling using NetworkX & Cytoscape.js, and explainable AI risk scoring.
